scenario.name: lidar_dropout
scenario.description: The lidar stops delivering scans while the robot drives to its second stop.

ground_truth.summary: No lidar scans reach Nav2; costmaps and localization stop updating and the collision monitor has no data.

alerts: the supervisor is holding after a failed goal: Navigation failed on the way to PICK_B; holding for recovery before the retry
scans stopped arriving at about 20.0 s and never resumed (normal rate 5.0 Hz)

actions.why: this process was seen dead or silent

diagnosis.root_cause: The lidar stopped delivering data at 20.0 s, causing the collision monitor to lose valid source data and the controller_server to fail pose transformations due to missing sensor updates.
evidence: Lidar scans stopped arriving at about 20.0 s
Collision monitor warnings starting at 21.1 s regarding invalid source
Controller server errors at 21.2 s due to transformPose failures

decision.note: The diagnosis indicates the lidar stopped delivering data (sensor_dropout). The only action that directly addresses this root cause from the provided list is restarting the lidar_driver process. No parameters need restoration, no relocalization is required yet (as the sensor failure is the primary issue), and parcels are not blocked by static obstacles but by the lack of sensor data.

incidents.settled: scans at 5.3 Hz and every heartbeat present, 5 s after the fix
